source: https://statistik.bra.se/solwebb/action/index (Brå – Brottsförebyggande rådet, official Swedish national crime-prevention council)
title: Anmälda brott, Totalt antal brott, 2025, per Stadsdelsområde (Sthlm)
extraction_method: Live query built via statistik.bra.se/solwebb query tool (old frameset UI), region=area select filtered to the 11 currently-active 'Stadsdelsområde X (Sthlm)' options (excluding all options marked 'upphörde', which are discontinued historical district schemes), brott=Totalt antal brott, period=2025, enhet=Antal brott. Result table read directly from the 'soktabell' frame via JS.
note: These are Brå's own police-district 'Stadsdelsområde' boundaries, which may not match Stockholm kommun's 14 official stadsdelsnämnder one-to-one (Brå shows an 11-district scheme active since a 2024-01-01 reorganization that merged some districts).
